name: Odette
source:
Odette: innocent, pure and foolish. Odile: clever but fragile at heart. The two are similar in their beauty. 

Odile, who is quick-witted and to the point, mocks, taunts, and oppresses the quiet, weak-minded Odette.

After being cursed to turn into a swan, Odette alights by the lake only during the night, which is when the power of her curse wanes.

[translated from [url=https://www.liar.co.jp/fairy/index.html]official website[/url]]
